blocks.text: Fungi eukaryotic aur heterotrophic jandar hain jo unicellular ya multicellular ho sakte hain. In ke cells par chitin (ek polysaccharide) ki cell wall hoti hai. Fungi ghiza ek khaas tareeqe se lete hain: yeh janwaron aur kuch protists ki tarah khana nigalte (ingest) nahi, balke apne ird gird se ghiza absorb (jazb) karte hain. Misaalein: mushrooms (khumbi), rusts, smuts aur molds (phaphoond).
Kuch fungi bread, cheese aur beer banane mein istemal hote hain. Kuch dawa ke kaam aate hain, jaise penicillin, ek antibiotic jo fungus Penicillium se hasil hoti hai.
Fungi ke bare groups yeh hain:

Fungi ki taqreeban 100,000 maloom species hain. Zyada tar Ascomycetes lichens (fungus aur alga ki saajhedaari) mein milte hain, aur kuch mycorrhizae (fungus aur podon ki jaron ki saajhedaari) mein milte hain.

items: Zygomycota mein woh fungi aate hain jin ke hyphae mein septa (cross walls, yani andar ki deewarein) nahi hote. Misal: Rhizopus (bread mold), jo geeli bread aur phalon par ugta hai.
Ascomycota fungi ke sab se bare groups mein se hai. In ke hyphae septate hain, yani un mein septa hote hain. Misaalein: aam molds, morels, truffles, cup fungi, Neurospora aur yeasts (khameer).
Basidiomycota mein septate hyphae wale fungi aate hain. Misaalein: mushrooms, toadstools, puffballs, jelly fungi, bracket ya shelf fungi, rusts aur smuts.

blocks.alt: Ek qataar mein chaar flat tasveerein, naam neeche: Smut fungi on leaf, hare patte par smut spores ki bhoori-narangi dhaariyan; Toadstool, jangal ki zameen par safed dandiyon wali laal topiyan jin par safed nuqte hain; Bracket fungi, darakht ke tane par tah-ba-tah peeli-narangi shelves (chhajje); Sweet Tooth Fungi, moti safed dandi wala halka kreem rang ka mushroom.
